Package com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.security

Class KfeJwtVerifier

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.security.KfeJwtVerifier
public class KfeJwtVerifier extends Object
Verifies signed JWTs, enforces configured issuer/audience/expiration policy, checks revocation, and extracts normalized role claims. A previous signing key is accepted only until its explicit expiry; unavailable revocation dependencies are represented separately from invalid credentials.

  • Constructor Details

    • KfeJwtVerifier

      public KfeJwtVerifier(@Value("${api.secret.token.secret}") String secret, org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate> redisTemplate, @Value("${kfe.security.jwt.revocation-check-enabled:true}") boolean revocationCheckEnabled, @Value("${kfe.auth.revocation.required:false}") boolean revocationRequired, @Value("${kfe.auth.jwt.issuer:}") String issuer, @Value("${kfe.auth.jwt.audience:}") String audience, @Value("${api.secret.token.previous:}") String previousSecret, @Value("${api.secret.token.previous.expires-at:}") String previousSecretExpiresAt)
      Creates the verifier from application properties and an optional Redis dependency.
      Parameters:
      secret - current HMAC signing secret
      redisTemplate - provider for the optional Redis revocation client
      revocationCheckEnabled - whether to query revocation state
      revocationRequired - whether unavailable revocation state blocks authentication
      issuer - required token issuer, or blank to disable issuer matching
      audience - required token audience, or blank to disable audience matching
      previousSecret - optional previous HMAC key for rotation
      previousSecretExpiresAt - ISO-8601 expiry required when previousSecret is configured
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for invalid keys or missing/invalid previous-key expiry

  • Method Details

    • verify

      public io.jsonwebtoken.Claims verify(String token)
      Parses a token with the current key, falling back to the nonexpired previous key, then applies claims policy. Expiration is mandatory; issuer and audience are enforced when configured; missing jti is warned.
      Parameters:
      token - compact signed JWT supplied by the caller
      Returns:
      verified claims when signature, time, configured identity, and revocation checks pass
      Throws:
      io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException - if no active key verifies the token
      IllegalStateException - if required claims fail or the session is revoked
      com.kerosene.kfe.bootstrap.security.KfeAuthenticationUnavailableException - if mandatory revocation proof is unavailable

    • roles

      public List<String> roles(io.jsonwebtoken.Claims claims)
      Extracts the roles collection, normalizes entries, removes duplicates, and defaults to USER.
      Parameters:
      claims - verified token claims
      Returns:
      immutable normalized roles, or a single USER role when no usable roles exist
